Products.title: Product Management
Products.subtitle: Add, edit, and manage products and inventory.
Products.emptyDescription: Add your first product, then manage its sizes, colors and stock in one place.
Products.noResultsDescription: Try a different name or clear your filters.
Products.basicHint: Give your product a clear name in both languages.
Products.slugHint: Use English letters, numbers and hyphens, for example: winter-kids-set.
Products.noCategories: Create a category before adding a product.
Products.imagesHint: Select product photos, upload them, then save the product. You can add descriptions in both languages.
Products.publicIdHint: The image identifier from your media library, for example products/winter-set.
Products.variantsHint: Each size and color has its own price and stock quantity.
Products.retireHint: Saved variants stay linked to orders. Deactivate a variant to stop selling it.
Products.deleteQuestion: Are you sure you want to delete this product?
Products.deleteWarning: Deletion is permanent. Products linked to orders cannot be deleted; you can deactivate them instead.

errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to manage products.
errors.notFound: This product no longer exists. Refresh the list.
errors.duplicateSlug: This product link is already in use. Choose another link.
errors.orders: This product is linked to orders and cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
errors.conflict: This product changed while you were editing. Close the form and reopen it before trying again.
errors.invalid: Some information could not be saved. Check the fields and try again.
errors.category: This category is no longer available. Choose another category.
errors.network: Could not connect. Check your connection and try again.
errors.server: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.busy: Please wait for the current action to finish.
errors.validation: Check the highlighted fields. Required names cannot be blank; prices must be nonnegative and stock must be a whole number.
errors.duplicates: Use a unique stock code and size/color combination for every variant, including inactive ones.
errors.imageType: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
errors.imageSize: Each image must be 5 MB or smaller. Try a smaller image.
errors.imageInvalid: This image could not be read. Choose a valid, non-animated image under 40 megapixels.
errors.uploadBody: The image could not be sent. Choose the file again.
errors.uploadUnavailable: Image uploads are unavailable. Ask the store administrator to check the image storage settings.
errors.uploadFailed: The image could not be uploaded. Try again or remove it from the selection.

Products.uploadLimits: JPEG, PNG or WebP · up to 5 MB per image
Products.uploadSuccess: Images uploaded. Save the product to keep your changes.
Products.uploadsPending: Upload or remove all selected images before saving the product.
